site.calendar: working days are Monday-Friday except US federal holidays, when the building is closed

slab.system: thermally activated building system (concrete core activation), cooling only
slab.soffit: exposed concrete, painted, no suspended ceiling or acoustic panels; emissivity 0.92
slab.top_side: raised access floor over a 150 mm unconditioned plenum; treated as adiabatic in the design calculation

envelope.shading: interior roller blinds in five bays, occupant-operated: occupants lower a bay when sun reaches their desks and reset the blinds when they arrive

ventilation.system: dedicated outdoor air system, sensible supply at 19 C, no recirculation
ventilation.schedule: full flow 06:00-19:00 on working days, 30 % of design flow at all other times

internal_gains.note: actual occupancy varies from day to day and is not metered

west.furnishings: open-plan desks, storage and glazed partitions
west.name: Level 3 west perimeter

tabs_group.description: both zones are served by one TABS manifold fed directly by a dedicated chiller; the chiller's leaving water is the slab supply for both zones
tabs_group.zone_valves: one on/off valve per zone; the BMS can hold each valve open for any whole number of minutes in a 15-minute interval (valve command = open fraction)
tabs_group.sensors: chiller leaving (supply) water temperature, and per zone: air temperature, embedded slab temperature, return water temperature; no flow meters
tabs_group.balancing_note: the commissioning report records both zones as balanced to design flow; they were not re-measured after the 2016 manifold replacement
